instruction: Use the registered cross-profile dataset. Record observed_host trials with profile_id, case_id, status, provider, exact model_revision, device and elapsed_ms. COMPLETE requires a confined output and sha256. FAILED requires failure_stage=model|check|compiler and a short reason_code; do not store prompts, tracebacks or error text. visual_review requires reviewer_type=human and separately assessed dimensions. Keep model outcome, image checks, compiler checks, Human visual review and user acceptance distinct. Missing trials and reviews remain UNKNOWN or UNVERIFIED. A valid image is not a quality rating.
